methodology.eligibility_rule: Remove duplicates within a category, permanently closed places, adult-only venues, and entries without enough evidence to identify the place or active seasonal operator.

geographic_tiers.metro: More than 25 and up to 60 estimated driving miles.
geographic_tiers.day_trip: More than 60 and up to 150 estimated driving miles.
geographic_tiers.exceptional_overnight: Beyond 150 miles only when distinctiveness materially outweighs distance; never present as an ordinary day trip.

methodology.scoring_formula: candidate_score_5 = 40% family_fit + 35% uniqueness + 25% evidence_quality. Final publication should also penalize distance, high cost, age mismatch, and lack of availability in the current July vacation window.
methodology.ratings_policy: Commercial ratings and review counts are null because no consistent, licensed public places-data source exposed comparable values across the pool.
methodology.address_policy: Addresses were taken from official or authoritative destination sources where confidently available; reservation-only locations retain null street address and explicit location notes.
methodology.image_policy: Every record includes an official-page visual lead and a Wikimedia Commons discovery URL. Neither is automatically cleared. Final video production must verify a specific asset's license, attribution, model/property releases, and trademark constraints before download or use.
